### Added
- **A ModelConfig in an Organization namespace names only a tenant credential; the platform's copied Secrets are written only by agent-manager.** With kagent on, the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy `agent-platform-tenant-model-credentials` (`Fail`, bound with `Deny`) refuses, in every namespace labelled `giantswarm.io/organization` but the kagent namespace and for every requester, a ModelConfig (any served version) whose `spec.apiKeySecret` is not a `tenant-credential-*` Secret, the prefix an EgressPolicy's `secretKeyRef` already keeps there. The exception is agent-manager's tenant reconciler (agent-manager on and `tenants.organizations.enabled`), which writes the copy of the platform's default ModelConfig. A ModelConfig without `apiKeySecret` is admitted. With agent-manager on and `tenants.organizations.enabled`, `agent-platform-tenant-platform-secrets` (`Fail`, `Deny`) lets only the reconciler's ServiceAccount create, update or delete a Secret in those namespaces that carries its label `agent-manager.giantswarm.io/tenant-object` (before or after the write) or is named as the default ModelConfig's key Secret (`kagent.providers.<default>.apiKeySecretRef`); the namespace and garbage collectors may delete one, so a namespace can still go. Every other Secret there, the tenant's `tenant-credential-*` ones included, stays with RBAC. `agent-platform-tenant-platform-secret-refs` (`Fail`, `Deny`, same switches) refuses there, for every requester, an Agent or AgentTemplate whose skill or plugin git source names the copied model key Secret as `credentialRef`, and a RemoteMCPServer whose `headersFrom` names it as a Secret; other Secrets stay referable (agent-manager names the installation's skills credential). A key Secret named with the `tenant-credential-` prefix fails the render. **An installation with an Organization's own ModelConfig on a Secret without the prefix renames that Secret to `tenant-credential-<name>` before the step; the existing ModelConfig keeps working until its next update.** `make verify-tenant-rbac` asserts both policies' shape. Needs Kubernetes 1.30 or later.
### Fixed
- **The kagent namespace's EgressPolicies are no longer readable by every signed-in person.** `agent-platform:user` read `egresspolicies.api.kagent.dev` in every namespace that binds it, and the kagent namespace binds it to `tenants.platform.users` (default `system:authenticated`), so the platform tenant's egress origins and the names of the Secrets they use were listed to everyone. The kagent namespace now binds `tenants.platform.users` to the new ClusterRole `agent-platform:platform-user`, `agent-platform:user` without EgressPolicies, through the RoleBinding `agent-platform:platform-user`; the RoleBinding `agent-platform:user` there is removed by the step (a binding's role cannot change in place). A tenant's `agent-platform:user`, `:editor` and `:admin` keep the read in their namespace; the kagent namespace's editors keep it there. `make verify-tenant-rbac` asserts it.
